== Summary ==
[[2009 World Championship]], Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey, 10 October 2009 (date from the camera's date stamp): a player captioned "Mr. Fred, bills,packers,texans,etc.". Identified: [[Brian Fred]].

== Source ==
Photo by Flickr user punkybear (forum user Nibcrom), album "philly and jersey worlds": [https://www.flickr.com/photos/punkybear/4096152973/ Mr. Fred, bills,packers,texans,etc.] (original image https://live.staticflickr.com/2765/4096152973_7be1da823c_b.jpg). Several were posted to the forum thread [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=31192 2009 Worlds pictures] (topic 31192), e.g. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=482550#p482550 post by Nibcrom], 12 November 2009.
